message.content: In their conversations, LiHua expresses enthusiasm for adding certain songs to the karaoke playlist. Specifically, he suggests "Sweet Caroline" and "Dancing Queen." LiHua believes these songs will appeal to a wide audience and add a fun and upbeat element to the karaoke session. LiHua also mentions a preference for classics, indicating that he likes to sing along to well-known and beloved songs from various eras.
